In one line: Bring measurable nature into daily contact, not decoration.
Palette: Forest and olive greens, clay, oat, raw timber, off-white
Materials: Live planting, timber veneer, cork, natural stone, jute, rattan
Lighting: Daylight-first, circadian tuning, dappled feature lighting
Imagery direction: Planted interiors, daylight studies, green walls, courtyards, texture close-ups
Copy tone: Calm, evidence-led; cite wellbeing and productivity research
Slides it adds or escalates: Planting plan, daylight study, maintenance and irrigation plan
Watch out for: Planting without an irrigation and maintenance contract dies in 6 months — say who waters it.

In one line: Reduce to essentials; let proportion and light do the work.
Palette: White, warm grey, black accents, single restrained accent hue
Materials: Micro-cement, matt laminate, glass, powder-coated steel, terrazzo
Lighting: Linear recessed, concealed cove, minimal fittings
Imagery direction: Clean wide shots, strong geometry, negative space, few props
Copy tone: Spare and confident; short lines, no adjective stacking
Watch out for: Minimal shows every tolerance. Detail and site quality must be budgeted, or it reads cheap.

In one line: Give people a setting per task instead of one desk for everything.
Palette: Zone-coded accents over a neutral base
Materials: Acoustic felt, writable surfaces, soft seating, mobile screens
Imagery direction: People in varied postures and settings, activity over architecture
Copy tone: Behavioural and practical; name the task each setting serves
Slides it adds or escalates: Settings menu, protocol/etiquette, change management, booking tech
Watch out for: ABW fails without an adoption programme. Budget the change management or it reverts to assigned desks in a quarter.

In one line: Leave the building's structure and services legible.
Palette: Concrete grey, black steel, rust, natural ply
Materials: Exposed soffit and services, mild steel, reclaimed timber, brick
Lighting: Suspended track and industrial fittings, visible conduit
Imagery direction: Exposed ceilings, structure close-ups, high-contrast shots
Copy tone: Direct and honest; talk about what is revealed rather than added
Watch out for: Exposed soffits wreck acoustics and raise HVAC load. Show the acoustic compensation in the same breath.

In one line: Root the workplace in its region's craft, material and story.
Palette: Regional earth tones, indigo, brass, terracotta
Materials: Local stone, handmade tile, regional craft inlay, brass, khadi textile
Lighting: Warm, layered, feature lighting on craft elements
Imagery direction: Craft detail macros, artisan process, regional architecture references
Copy tone: Narrative; name the craft, the region and the maker
Slides it adds or escalates: Craft sourcing and artisan partners, storytelling wall, art commissioning plan
Watch out for: Craft procurement has long, unreliable lead times. Put it on the programme slide, not in a footnote.

In one line: Make the workplace unmistakably, legibly this company.
Palette: The brand palette, used at architectural scale
Materials: Colour-blocked surfaces, custom graphics, signage-as-architecture, feature joinery
Lighting: Accent and colour-wash on brand moments
Imagery direction: Bold graphic interiors, branded thresholds, feature walls
Copy tone: Energetic and brand-voiced; borrow the client's own language
Slides it adds or escalates: Brand landscape, graphics and wayfinding family, feature-moment map
Watch out for: Brand refreshes outpace fit-outs. Keep the boldest colour on replaceable surfaces, not on tile and stone.

In one line: Design around comfort, recovery and human health outcomes.
Palette: Soft neutrals, muted blue-green, pale timber
Materials: Low-VOC finishes, acoustic ceilings, ergonomic furniture, tactile textiles
Lighting: Circadian tuning, glare control, individual user control
Imagery direction: Quiet rooms, wellness spaces, ergonomic detail, natural light
Copy tone: Care-led and specific; prefer measurable claims to vague comfort
Slides it adds or escalates: Wellness amenity set, acoustic comfort strategy, air-quality approach, ergonomics standard
Watch out for: Wellness claims invite measurement. Only claim what you will actually commission and test.

In one line: Design to a certifiable environmental standard and prove it.
Materials: Recycled and rapidly-renewable content, FSC timber, low-VOC, reused elements
Lighting: High-efficiency fittings, daylight harvesting, occupancy control
Imagery direction: Material provenance, reuse before/after, certification scorecards
Copy tone: Evidence-led; cite the standard, the credit and the number
Slides it adds or escalates: Certification pathway and scorecard, material provenance, reuse inventory, energy and water strategy
Watch out for: Certification targets change the programme and the budget. Commit to a rating level early or not at all.

In one line: Let the building sense, respond and report.
Palette: Cool neutrals, deep charcoal, luminous accents
Materials: Integrated screens, seamless surfaces, concealed services, glass
Imagery direction: Interfaces in situ, sensors, dashboards, AV-integrated rooms
Copy tone: Systems-led; name the platform and the integration
Slides it adds or escalates: Smart-workplace stack, sensor and data plan, AV standard by room type, booking integration
Watch out for: Occupancy sensing is a privacy conversation. Get HR and Legal in the room before it is specified.

In one line: Minimal discipline, warmed by timber, texture and softness.
Palette: Oat, warm white, pale timber, soft charcoal, muted sage
Materials: Pale oak, linen, paper-effect surfaces, matt ceramic, rattan
Imagery direction: Soft daylight, quiet compositions, texture and grain close-ups
Copy tone: Quiet and considered; restraint in the writing as well
Slides it adds or escalates: Texture and material close-ups, furniture curation
Watch out for: Pale timber and linen mark and stain fast. Check the maintenance regime honestly before specifying.

In one line: A gallery-like envelope that puts people and work in the frame.
Palette: Black, white, greyscale, one disciplined accent
Materials: Matt black metal, plaster, polished concrete, glass, neutral textile
Lighting: Gallery-grade track and accent lighting, high contrast
Copy tone: Editorial and typographic; let layout carry the emphasis
Slides it adds or escalates: Art and graphics programme, typography and signage system
Watch out for: High contrast is hard on screen work and on accessibility. Check luminance ratios at desks.

In one line: Use domestic comfort to make an office worth commuting to.
Palette: Warm neutrals, terracotta, muted blue, timber
Materials: Upholstered seating, rugs, curtains, domestic-scale lighting, open shelving
Lighting: Layered lamps and pendants at domestic scale, warm temperature
Imagery direction: Lounge settings, soft seating vignettes, people at ease
Copy tone: Warm and human; talk about belonging and choice
Slides it adds or escalates: Settings vignettes, soft-furnishing specification and cleaning regime
Watch out for: Domestic fabrics fail commercial abrasion and fire ratings. Specify contract-grade equivalents.

In one line: Cost per seat, and what was deliberately left out
Materials: Laminate, vinyl, modular ceilings, standard catalogue furniture
Slides it adds or escalates: Shortest deck. Merge space-by-space slides into grouped ones; cut detail and mock-up slides.

Materials: Veneer accents, engineered stone at key points, good contract furniture
Slides it adds or escalates: The baseline the library is written to. No adjustment.

In one line: Value and lifecycle, not unit rate
Materials: Natural stone, real veneer, designer furniture, bespoke joinery
Slides it adds or escalates: Adds detail, material-sample and lighting slides; space-by-space slides split rather than merge.

Materials: Marble, bespoke metalwork, commissioned art, bespoke lighting
Slides it adds or escalates: Longest deck. Adds art programme, mock-up, bespoke-joinery and provenance slides.
